aboutmeP:
My name is Žiga Hvalec and I am from Maribor. The joy of programming and computers has grown from a hobby to a serious work where I acquire new knowledge and practical experience. In my free time, I like to do sports, running, skiing, snowboarding and going to fitness. 
I am interested in everything related to computers, modern technologies and technical innovations in this area. 
Because I wanted to use my knowledge in practice I started first with summer work at a computer company. The experience was unique, I performed work related to databases and making windows applications in C#. Later I worked at Margento as front end developer. Now I work full time at d.labs as Web Developer. I am always open for new opportunities.
